candidate: Original and 90-degree CCW image, same fixed 27B/1536 model and original spatial prompt, each 900 tokens; second receives neither first answer nor order quantities. Keep only known equal class counts; disagreements null. No voting, deduplication, geometry correctness threshold or corrected quantities.
selection_data: Exactly existing 16 development photographs; the 48 already-inspected holdout photos are now regression only for v0.3.
gate_scope: Development selection only, never a deployment-risk or winner guarantee. Any fresh holdout will be frozen before running and cannot drive further tuning without becoming development.
fallback: If gate fails, keep candidate experimental; do not select by the old two holdout errors.
physics: Digital rotation adds no new physical evidence; calls from same model are correlated. Conflict regions use model centers only as approximate guides.
camera: Capture preview and explicit submission, captured order/revision binding; no completion automation.
